item.title: New USL academy team brings professional soccer pathway to Tallahassee
item.description: A partnership between Sporting Tallahassee, Sporting JAX, and Tallahassee Reckoning is creating a new opportunity for local players. Tryouts start in Spring 2026 with an inaugural season in May.

item.title: "I don't want to feel dirty": Leon County mobile home residents have not had running water for days
item.description: Residents at Sun State Estates Two say they have not running water for 5 days. They say the problem is forcing them to buy bottled water for basic needs.

item.title: Wakulla County 4-H helps students expand their cultural knowledge by hosting students from Japan
item.description: Wakulla County 4-H is hosting two students from Japan this school year. Giving them and local students a chance to learn about different cultures from one another.
